required_capabilities: Load Library Element Type (×2); Create Door (×2); Replace Element Type (×1); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: The room is a simple rectangle with four exterior walls already built; do not modify them. Place exactly two openings; corner distances are measured along the host wall. On the top (north) wall: a Rectangular Door Opening, 900 x 2100 mm, its left edge 3000 mm from the top-left corner. On the right (east) wall: a Double Door with 2 Sidelights, 2300 x 2100 mm, its edge nearest the top-right corner 2500 mm from that corner; it is the building's escape door and must swing in the escape direction. Create no other doors or openings.

doors.label: rectangular door opening on the north wall
double door with 2 sidelights on the east wall
